patterns.prevention:
• Assign a primary and backup coach to every centre at least two weeks before start date, with confirmed availability locked in writing.

• Conduct weekly coverage checks on Mondays to flag any gaps or coach absences for the following week, with 48-hour minimum notice for replacements.

• Establish a coach rotation schedule that prevents any single centre relying on one person, and ensure all coaches complete centre-specific induction before their first session.

• Document coach performance and attendance monthly; remove coaches with more than one missed session without 7 days' notice before issues escalate to centre cancellation.
